lock.prompt:
The first 4 images are photos of the same man: the identity reference. The last image is the photo to edit.

Edit the last image so that the man in it has this exact man's face: his face structure, jawline, nose, eyes, brows, lips, skin tone and beard exactly as in the reference photos. The man in the last image is only a look-alike: do not keep his face, render this man's own face from the reference photos in its place. Redraw his whole head as one, the hair included: his hair, beard and moustache exactly as in the reference photos (his own tight curly black hair), so that hair, face, ears and neck belong together like one real photograph. If the man in the last image wears glasses, he keeps wearing the same glasses. His expression: a genuine candid smile, the moment a friend's camera catches him really amused: his cheeks lifted, his eyes narrowed and crinkled at the corners, his lips parted in a natural smile with his upper teeth showing (his own teeth, a shade whiter); relaxed and warm, never a posed or forced grin.

- head: facing directly forward towards the camera, 0 degrees
- chin: chin is level and upright with no noticeable sideways tilt
- eyes: looking directly into the camera lens
- glasses: none
- hair: curly, voluminous, short-to-medium length, black/dark brown
- light on his face: diffuse frontal light slightly from above, warm natural tone, moderately bright
- how bright his face is: similar brightness to the beige background, skin looks smooth and clean with subtle natural texture

Keep his head at the same position, turn and tilt as in the last image, and the head, including the hair, exactly the same size as there, never larger. Keep his jaw, chin and neck exactly as clean as in the last image: no extra fold or double chin. The face has exactly the exposure, colour, contrast and grain of the photo around it, lit from the same direction, so it belongs in the picture like a real phone photo and not a studio portrait.
Keep everything else in the last image exactly as it is: neck, clothing, body, hands, pose, background and framing.
